title: Self-contained gate-elimination proof of coefficient/exponent pair (2, 1) for MOD_3

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. claims: Explicit lemma for the same family (proof.md Section 6): for every integer n>=3, C_B2(f_n)>=2n-6 in the full Li–Yang B2 model, where f_n(x)=1 iff the number of ones of x is divisible by 3.

Elimination step (proof.md Lemma 4): for every integer m>=4 and every residue s mod 3, writing M_{m,s}(y)=1 iff y_1+...+y_m == s (mod 3), C_B2(M_{m,s}) >= 2 + min over residues s' of C_B2(M_{m-1,s'}) in the full Li–Yang B2 model.
